limitations: Unknown participant relationships in GAVD; its source videos are grouping proxies.
Only 29 retained normal GAVD sources constrain nested reference fits and empirical rank resolution.
External evaluation uses dataset-coded identities and labels, acquisition-confounded observational videos, and no target-domain calibration.
The locked anomaly candidate does not beat the low-motion baseline internally or externally; no clinical discrimination superiority is claimed.

latent_objective.reason: The matched coordinate experiment shows no structured-mask advantage over uniform masking and no incremental anomaly advantage over the locked motion comparator. A latent-objective grid would not resolve that failure of the present reference design.

learned_masks.reason: The simpler structured masks do not improve on uniform masking. More adaptive mask optimization is not justified by the declared ladder.

phase_conditioning.reason: There is no frozen, manually validated phase estimator with two credible prefix cycles for this cohort.

stochastic_future.reason: The deterministic reference and masking arms have not established the intended incremental movement-organization endpoint. Proper probabilistic calibration would also require a new protocol and stronger independent normal support.

completion_record: Independent final acceptance is recorded separately in docs/reference_v2/final_acceptance.json.

failed_analyses.reason: Replay omitted the original intermediate CSV transport and failed exact primary-ranking agreement. No new scores were published.
